data.long_meaning: Santu is a Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'sant'. It means 'God', 'peaceful', or 'calm'. It is often used as a term of endearment and is a popular name in Hindu communities. The name Santu carries the meaning “God, Peaceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Assamese. Parents who choose Santu usually hope their child will grow to embody god, peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
